claims.text: IBM Research published Granite 4.2 on 2026-08-25: dense 3B/8B/30B reasoning LLMs with a three-way thinking switch and 512K context.

claims.text: 8B/30B models complete a multi-stage async-GRPO agentic RL pipeline (SWE -> Terminal -> Search) in real sandboxed environments; 3B stops after foundational RL.

claims.text: All weights, instruct checkpoints, and quantized variants ship under Apache 2.0 with OpenAI-compatible tool calling via vLLM.
